godot_forward: +Z in the file (cab at +Z); the visual definition turns it 180 degrees to -Z
collision_recommendation: Use simple BoxShape3D/CapsuleShape3D or custom RTS footprint data; do not use render mesh collision per unit.
source_pipeline: Sketchfab glTF-binary download (512 px textures, 114.8k triangles, 231 mesh pieces). Spec-gloss materials converted to metal-rough, meshes merged by material, sloppy simplification to ~16k triangles, textures resized to 256 px WebP, origin at the bottom centre. Credit in godot/project/credits.json.
